description: This file defines a linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving size, and accessing elements by index. It also includes an internal Node class and a companion object with a helper function.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with node management, element access, and manipulation methods.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helper method to remove a node from the list by adjusting pointers.
